structure: Each subject JSON is an object {subject, edition, editionNote, sources:[{title,url}], chapters:[]}

chapter.subject: math|physics|chemistry|biology|astronomy|coding
chapter.title: 一元二次方程
chapter.term: 上册|下册|全一册|复习|拓展

sections.title: Textbook section title
sections.body: 150-250 Chinese characters original explanation per major section

requirements: Every chapter >=3 sections, >=2 worked examples, >=6 quiz items of which 4 choice + 2 short. All questions distinct. Correct math, conditions, units, safe activities. No placeholders, no copied textbook paragraphs/exercises. Exact coverage labels; do not claim latest edition without primary evidence.
